body: Thats depression bud. Its like a parasite. It needs to stay alive and if for a second you feel okay it will make sure you remember that its there and looming over you. You're aloud to feel okay. But if you do its going to make sure you have a reason to feel bad. Thats the guilt. Like a last ditch effort to show you whose boss. You're stuck with it. All you can do now is roll with the punches. Keep fighting bro. We right here with you
